title: Quantum Algorithms for Heterogeneous PDEs: The Neutron Diffusion Eigenvalue Problem
summary: We develop a quantum algorithm to solve a type of linear reaction-diffusion equation, the neutron diffusion (generalized) k-eigenvalue problem that establishes nuclear criticality. The algorithm handles an equation with piecewise constant coefficients, describing a problem in a heterogeneous medium. We apply uniform finite elements and show that the quantum algorithm provides significant polynomial end-to-end speedup over classical uniform finite element methods in the cases tested, although nonuniform classical methods can perform much better than uniform ones.
